description: Accounts Instagram lists as related to a public profile (the suggested-accounts set in Instagram's web profile JSON, often up to ~50): ID, username, full name, verified and private flags, profile picture. No follower counts for the related accounts. Some accounts have no related list (empty result). Throttling gives 503 (not charged); unknown users 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

username.description: Instagram username (with or without @) or instagram.com/<user> URL
